relationship: Moving a piston changes the volume of a fixed gas at constant temperature, connecting collision frequency and pressure to the inverse pressure-volume relationship.

learnerLoop.action: Predict compression or expansion, move the piston, then use gauge readings and working to meet a pressure or volume target.
learnerLoop.modelChange: Volume changes while the model keeps the gas amount and temperature fixed; pressure and collision-rate evidence respond inversely.
learnerLoop.evidence: Particle motion, impact indicators, the pressure gauge, graph trace and pressure-volume product reveal the linked change.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Compare prediction with observation, calculate a new target, or pin readings to test the relationship in free investigation.

invariants: Pressure and volume satisfy the same constant product in the gauge, graph and calculation.
Constant temperature is represented by unchanged particle speed, not faster particles during compression.
Collision-frequency evidence changes with volume and stays distinct from particle-speed evidence.
Working assistance preserves the need to manipulate the piston and compare physical evidence.
safeAdaptations: Change target values, wording or working support within the supported volume range.
Add comparisons of pinned readings that test the inverse relationship.
nonGoals: Do not model changing temperature, changing gas amount or non-ideal gas behaviour.
Do not replace the piston investigation with a formula-only quiz.

goal.visibility: Present in the current investigation; child controls follow the mode and state.

apparatus.description: Sealed particles, piston, pressure gauge, impact frequency and p–V graph.
apparatus.visibility: Present in the current investigation; child controls follow the mode and state.

working.description: Prediction followed by supplied or learner-calculated pressure/volume and marker.
working.visibility: Present in the current investigation; child controls follow the mode and state.

evidence.description: Causal chain and invariant under the apparatus.
evidence.visibility: Present in the current investigation; child controls follow the mode and state.

completion.visibility: After target reached and any required marker/working is accepted.

volume.source: Starting/target values from current case; learner moves piston.
volume.output: Gauge, graph and particle impacts update.

pressure.description: Pressure p = K/V, with K fixed.
pressure.source: Measured from current volume; later calculated before moving piston.
pressure.output: Same value on gauge, graph and work.

working.description: Product p₁V₁ and required pressure or volume.
working.domain: Two scalar steps of one invariant calculation.
working.source: Some supplies product; All asks product and target value.
working.output: Accepted work places a prediction marker before physical test.

modes.observe: Compression and expansion establish relationship before calculation levels unlock.
modes.none: Guided gauge test or supplied calculation; physical piston action remains.
modes.some: Enter target pressure/volume using supplied product.
modes.free: Pin readings and inspect the same fixed-temperature model.

dependencies: Earned calculation support follows the first two tests.
Owned values must place an accepted marker before piston verification.
implementation.completion: maybeComplete checks targetReached and working/marker prerequisites; release snaps within target tolerance. Generated practice retains support.
limitations: Fixed temperature, particle count and piston area; idealised impact illustration, not a molecular dynamics solver.
